answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, weighted by independent path length, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The anchor holds work receipts rather than names, so the quartz of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. What survives to the terrace is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
